options.label: One branch per ticket → PR each
options.description: Mirrors the existing #2 pattern (one feature branch → merge commit per ticket). Cleaner history, more overhead. Branches: scrub-test-utils (#3), remove-jar (#4), license (#5), readme (#6), secrets-doc (#8), security-md, contributing (#13).

options.label: One bundled go-public branch → single PR/merge
options.description: All changes on one branch like 'go-public-docs', single merge commit. Faster to land; bundles 7 tickets into one PR.

options.label: Drop straight into main as uncommitted changes
options.description: Apply the worktree's diff + untracked files to the current main checkout, leave uncommitted so you can review/stage manually.
